manifest.name: dsh-av-sync-gate
manifest.description: 声画同步闸：解说视频的画面对音轨漂移终结核——输入各段配音实测时长，输出逐段帧计划（段长=配音+0.25秒呼吸位·基址/帧数/跨度），另带帧号空洞检测（ffmpeg遇缺号即停·成片腰斩的头号元凶）；拼接视频前过闸，话没说完图先跳这种病出厂前死掉；v1.1新增字幕逐句同步act（段内按字数权重切句比例排布·标点挂前句尾）与视觉层级铁律（文字永压形象上·立绘≤50%）。

readme.text:
**Audio-visual sync gate** for narrated slideshow videos. The #1 failure mode:
picture cuts while the voice is still talking, and it drifts worse every
segment. Root cause: visual segments ignore the tail silence between voice
clips. This gate computes the exact frame plan so picture and audio stay
locked, end to end.

```
segment_seconds = voiceover_seconds + 0.25   (breath gap, configurable)
frames          = ceil(segment_seconds × fps)
```

ffmpeg stops encoding at the first missing frame number — a single hole cuts
your video in half. `act=check` compares expected vs actual frame count and
tells you to renumber sequentially before muxing.

```bash
dsh plugin add github:<owner>/dsh-av-sync-gate
curl "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/av-sync/api?act=plan&durs=4.7,7.2,8.3&fps=30"
curl "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/av-sync/api?act=check&count=1611&expected=1615"
```

`GET /av-sync/api?act=subtitle&text=...&dur=8.8` — splits segment text into
phrases (punctuation stays at the tail of the previous phrase), schedules each
by character-weight proportion across the voiceover window. Powers on-screen
subtitles that switch exactly when the voice says the next phrase.

Portrait first, text last — text always renders above the character art;
character art ≤50% of frame height, proportional scaling only.
